name: Simon Lineker
caption: A fictional Olympic freestyle-wrestling gold medalist signed to a three-year deal as The Death Collective's marquee attraction, confronted at his own signing press conference by a masked rival calling himself Nuckelavee.

tenures.source: The Death Collective's own Simon Lineker press conference and Black Market TV 01 event poster

name: Nuckelavee
caption: A masked, sea-demon-named heel who crashed Simon Lineker's own signing press conference to announce their upcoming Black Market TV match.

tenures.source: The Death Collective's own Simon Lineker press conference and Black Market TV 01 event poster

name: Robby Leland
caption: The Death Collective's own on-screen Talent Relations executive, who presided over Simon Lineker's own signing press conference.

tenures.source: The Death Collective's own Simon Lineker press conference

name: Ill Fortune
caption: A wrestler advertised for the fed's own debut Black Market TV broadcast against Money Talks; no result survives on the record.

name: Money Talks
caption: A wrestler advertised for the fed's own debut Black Market TV broadcast against Ill Fortune; no result survives on the record. Whether this billed name names one entrant or a pair is not stated in the source.
